'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Steve Brentson DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Brentson]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
